These four files in openmrs-esm-patient-chart import the `Concept` type from `@openmrs/esm-framework`. I did not open openmrs-esm-core to read the definition. I found these with text searches for the import, so a usage that doesn't import `Concept` by that name would be missed.

1. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-notes-app/src/notes/visit-notes.resource.ts`: imports `Concept` at line 9. Line 105 uses it as the response type, `openmrsFetch<Array<Concept>>(url)`, and returns `data['results']`. A change to the `Concept` shape would hit this concept search.
2. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/app/form-data-source/form-data-source.service.ts`: imports `Concept` at line 13.
   - `getConceptCode` (line 28) takes a `Concept`.
   - Line 286 casts a result with `concept as Concept`.
   - `mapConcept` (line 347) takes a `Concept`. Both functions read concept fields, so they are the most exposed.
3. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/obs-table-horizontal/obs-table-horizontal.component.tsx`: imports `Concept` at line 13. It is used in two props types, `concepts: Array<Concept>`, at lines 274 and 381.
4. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/postOrders.ts`: imports `Concept` at line 2. Line 132 declares `concept: Concept | string`, which sits in the order payload type.
